question: Should maintainers land the base family-history PR first and then rebase this carryover PR, or accept this PR as the combined includeFamily plus carryover landing path?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and well-tested, but the permanent product boundary controls model access to archived reset summaries and changes protocol/config surfaces, so maintainer intent is required before merge.

options.title: Land the base first
options.body: Merge the family-history selector path first, then rebase this PR so carryover lands as a smaller default-off follow-up.

options.title: Accept the combined stack
options.body: Merge this PR as the combined family-history and carryover path, owning the broader release and review surface in one landing.

options.title: Defer carryover
options.body: Keep explicit family history moving while pausing automatic prompt carryover until archived-context exposure policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Land the base first
recommendation.body: Merge the family-history selector path first, then rebase this PR so carryover lands as a smaller default-off follow-up.
